findings.problem: Mandatory display structural-v2-tell_tale_indicators-2 drops the printed qualifier '(until or after vehicle running for a particular distance / speed)'. That qualifier is the only page-62 statement that the start-up ABS lamp normally stays ON until the motorcycle has moved. Without it, 'ON during the initial check-up ... Do not run the motorcycle if the ABS indicator lamp remains continuously ON' can still be read as 'lamp still ON at standstill means do not ride', which is the F5 concern. A WARNING display must not drop a condition. (My own round-2 suggested wording had the same omission.)
findings.evidence_from_page: p62 (printed 60): '(3) ABS - Will be continuously ON during initial check up (until or after vehicle running for a particular distance / speed) and will turn OFF if system is ok, then will light up again in case of any ABS system malfunction.' CAUTION: 'Do not run motorcycle in case the ABS indicator lamp continuously "ON".'
findings.required_fix: Change only this display text, e.g.: 'The ABS indicator is ON during the initial check-up (until or after the vehicle has run a particular distance/speed) and turns OFF if the system is OK; it lights up again in case of any ABS system malfunction. Do not run the motorcycle if the ABS indicator lamp remains continuously ON.' Keep the same evidence_ids.
